caption.body:
100 export product ideas to research from India.

This is a starting list, not a promise of profit. Food and farm products, home and lifestyle goods, industrial parts and textiles all have exporters and buyers, but the right choice depends on your supply, your costs and your target market.

Pick two or three ideas that match what you can source reliably, find their HS codes, check trade data for demand and competition, and test with samples before you invest.
